POMO ecosystem －

Blockchain data-driven membership system

POMO Network creates a dedicated membership system and a user-centric Web3 experience that enhances the bond between merchants and users.

Role

Product Designer

Company

POMO Network

Time

Q1-Q3 2024

[ Pain Points ]

The shortcomings of traditional membership systems

  • [1]
    Loyalty Points without Cumulative Value

    Scattered points prevent value accumulation across different systems.

  • [2]
    Complex Membership Card Management

    Fragmented card management is inefficient and cumbersome for users.

  • [3]
    Absence of Personalized Persona

    Generic systems lack personalized personas, forcing repetitive identity verification.

[ What is POMO ecosystem ]

Your Contribution, Your Rewards.

  • [Users-1]
    Merchant

    Build closer connections by offering membership rights and personalized experiences based on consumer behavior.

  • [Platform]
    POMO Network

    Provides Web3 infrastructure that tokenizes contributions and enables a circular economy.

  • [Users-2]
    Consumer

    Earn tradable Membership card and $POMO tokens through active participation.

[ Products ]

Including B2B / B2C system with integrated backend and frontend

POMO Curator (B2B)

A no-code NFT launchpad for seamless project deployment

Pass Token (ERC721)

A parent-level digital membership or VIP pass that enables merchants to design tiered levels, personalized content, and targeted marketing campaigns tailored to specific customer profiles.

Voucher Token (ERC1155)

A child-level voucher similar to traditional coupons. It enables issuers to create unique, brand-aligned experiences to foster deeper customer engagement. (e.g., Venue-wide round of shots; max 5 times per night)

POMO App (B2C)

A mobile gateway for discovering tailored services from diverse merchants

Explore Curated Experiences

Unlock unique membership benefits and personalized perks from our curated merchant network through POMO App

Earn tokens & Redeem utilities

Accumulate tokens to activate exclusive services, special offers, and premium experiences.

[ Scenario1 ]

How can brand users deploy member projects from POMO Curator to the POMO App?

＊All content is for demonstration purposes only.

[ Step 1 ]

Create first membership project

Set the tone for your brand and showcase your unique style to every customer.

[ Step 2 ]

Create welcome gift

Design tangible utilities and unique consumption experiences to engage your customers.

[ Step 3 ]

Ready to Deploy

Once your request is submitted, the POMO team will conduct a manual review before deploying the project to the blockchain.

[ Step 4 ]

Display on the App

Deployment complete. Your project is now live and ready to be explored on the POMO App.

[ Scenario2 ]

How can customers claim their first membership card and redeem vouchers on the POMO App?

＊All content is for demonstration purposes only.

[ Step 1 ]

Discover your favorite merchants

Explore our curated selection of merchants who prioritize exceptional dining and service experiences.

[ Step 2 ]

View details and Claim your free membership

Tap the button to claim your first LV1 membership card for free—an effortless way to start your brand journey.

[ Step 3 ]

Redeem a voucher

Choose the membership gift you wish to use; each reward can be redeemed with staff during your visit.

[ Step 4 ]

Confirm and show your screen

Confirm the redemption and show the screen to the staff. Enjoy your exclusive VIP experience!

NEXT PROJECT

Optimize the token claiming process with NFC
